Run Python code and learn Python on your mobile Device.
Become a Pythonista with this AI powered mobile programming editor.

Python coding on your mobile phone.
You can run, execute, and evaluate Python code, scripts, and programs from this app. 
Python 3 interpreter and compiler on your device.

Write functions, and classes and import modules from the Standard Library.
Run your scripts and programs with a single tap, and see the output in a console window.
Built-in AI Assistance, whenever you get an error in your code, AI can suggest how to resolve it.
AI Assistant can refactor your code, clean it up, check it for bugs, write comments and docstrings or just explain it.

This is the perfect app for anyone who wants to learn Python and write Python code.

Learn Python with the official tutorial.
Read the official Standard Library documentation from the app.
Learn about data types, functions, classes, and programming constructs.

Edit your code with a full-featured code editor that supports code syntax highlighting, undo and redo, opening files, themes, colors, and fonts.

Test your programming knowledge, the coding editor will tell you if you are writing valid code.

Whether you are a beginner or a professional, this app will help you improve your Python programming skills. Use this coding editor to become a Pythonista and a better developer.

Note that certain features are available only with the developer upgrade.

record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Describe what you want in plain English and get a program that runs. AI Code Generator is a coding assistant, code editor and compiler in one app: the model writes the program, you run it on your iPhone or iPad, then keep it and grow it into a project.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Type one sentence, for example "a button that changes the page colour when tapped" or "a Python function that checks if a word is a palindrome".
2. Pick a language, or let your sentence decide.
3. The generator writes it, and it runs right away: a live preview for HTML, CSS and JavaScript, real output for Python, Java, C++ and more.
4. Keep it, edit it in the editor, run it again, or turn it into a multi-file project.

GENERATE FROM A PROMPT
• Turn a prompt into functions, classes, SQL queries, small web pages, algorithms
• Choose which model does the writing, from fast to more powerful
• Recent generations are kept on your home screen, so you can reopen any of them
• Works as a code writer for boilerplate, a quick script or a language you do not use every day

WHAT PEOPLE ASK FOR
• "A to-do list page with add and delete buttons" in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
• "Bubble sort in C++ with comments on each step"
• "A Java class for a bank account with deposit and withdraw"
• "An SQL query for the top 5 customers by revenue"
• "Read a CSV file in Python and print the average of a column"

CODE EDITOR FOR 30 LANGUAGES
Start from a blank file or from a generation. The editor covers Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C, C++, C#, Go, Kotlin, Swift, PHP, Ruby, Dart, Pascal, Lua, R, Scala, Haskell, Elixir, Erlang, Clojure, Groovy, Objective-C and SQL, plus HTML, CSS, JSON, XML, YAML and Markdown.

BUILT-IN COMPILER AND CODE RUNNER
• Tap Run and see the output: no setup, no environment to install
• Online compiler for Python, Java, C++, C, C#, Go, Kotlin, PHP, Ruby and more
• Use it as a Python compiler, a Java compiler or a C++ compiler for homework, interview practice and quick tests
• HTML, CSS and JavaScript render as a live preview you can tap

AI REVIEW (PRO)
Open any file and ask it to:
• Explain it line by line, in plain words

Kilo Code App is the mobile companion for Kilo Code, the open source agentic engineering platform. Code, monitor, and steer your agents from your phone, wherever you are.

→ Code from your phone with Cloud Agents
Spin up a Kilo Cloud Agent, give it a task, and review its work from the chat. Full agentic coding, backed by Kilo's managed infrastructure, without opening a laptop.

Pair with a Kilo session running in Kilo CLI or VS Code on your computer. Send instructions, review diffs, and keep an eye on long-running tasks while you're away from the desk.

→ Watch your agents in real time
See sessions running outside the app — CLI, IDE, Slack, or cloud — in a live read-only view. Know what your agents are doing, even when you can't intervene.

→ Review pull requests
Paste a GitHub PR link to see checks and full file diffs with syntax highlighting. Leave line-level comments, batch them into a review, approve, reply in threads, and merge.

→ Work by voice, or from anywhere
Dictate prompts instead of typing. Queue follow-ups while an agent is working. Attach any file type. Share links, text, and files into Kilo from any app's share sheet.

→ Get pinged when an agent needs you

record.description_evidence:
AnyEnv is an AI coding workspace in the cloud. Describe what you want to build, and let AI help you write, change and understand code. Projects run in cloud sandboxes, so your computer does not need to stay busy. From your iPhone or iPad, you can open a workspace, guide an agent, and follow previews, deployments and usage.

Start with a request in your own words. Launch a task from Explore, or use planning mode to analyze your goal and create an engineering plan before you approve execution. Build a new project, improve a feature, fix a problem, or break a larger idea into manageable tasks.

Choose from multiple coding agents, including Auto, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, Qwen CLI, OpenCode, Qoder CLI, CodeBuddy Code and Trae Agent. Availability depends on your account configuration. Send instructions, review sensitive actions, add context, or branch from an earlier message to continue in a new direction.

Open a browser preview, terminal or remote desktop when you need to inspect your work. Workspace preparation, startup and recovery states are shown as they happen. Continue on your computer through the browser or desktop client. Save checkpoints at important stages and roll back when you need an earlier project state.

Prefer working on your own computer? Connect a local device and workspace through AnyEnv CLI, then use your phone to manage local agent or CLI sessions. Send instructions, check progress and respond to requests for confirmation while you are away from your desk. Your connected computer must remain online.

Manage everyday development in one place. Check project progress and Git connections, organize work in task boards and lists, collect issues, review deployment settings and track release results. Manage integrations for Git, models and cloud services through tools and credentials. Purchase Coffee Beans through Apple In-App Purchase to cover model, cloud sandbox and deployment usage, and review your balance and itemized charges.

Use iPhone for quick updates on the go. On iPad, portrait mode provides more room to browse, while wide and landscape layouts offer a workspace with multiple panels for conversations and previews.

Before you use platform-provided AI services, AnyEnv discloses the actual recipient and requests your consent. You can decline or withdraw consent later. When you use your own credentials, data is sent to the service you configure. Your code, projects and conversations are used for the features you choose to use, and AnyEnv does not use them to train models. Third-party providers may have their own data policies.

record.name: Zedra - AI Coding Agents
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your coding agents run on your own machine. Zedra puts them in your pocket.

Start a task on your laptop, walk away, and keep working from your phone. Zedra connects straight to your development machine, so you can watch agents work, answer their questions, review the diff, and start the next task from anywhere.

WORKS WITH THE AGENTS YOU ALREADY USE
Claude Code, Codex, opencode, and any other CLI agent or shell command. Zedra runs a real terminal, not a chat mirror, so nothing about your setup has to change.

RUN A SWARM, NOT A SESSION
Most work is several agents at once. Zedra shows every session on one screen with live status, so you can see which agent is thinking, which one finished, and which one is blocked waiting on you.

NEVER MISS AN APPROVAL
Agents stop and ask before they touch anything important. Zedra sends a push notification the moment one needs you, so a waiting agent is never a surprise you find twenty minutes later.

A REAL TERMINAL
Full terminal emulation with color, mouse reporting, and TUI support. A keyboard row built for code gives you arrows, tab, escape, and control without fighting the on-screen keyboard. Paste screenshots straight into a prompt.

READ THE DIFF BEFORE YOU MERGE
Syntax-highlighted diffs, file trees, and git status. Select code in the editor or a file preview and send it straight to an agent with Add to Chat, without switching apps.

CONNECTS DIRECTLY, NOT THROUGH US
Pair by scanning a QR code once. Zedra builds an encrypted peer-to-peer connection between your phone and your machine, and falls back to a relay only when your network blocks a direct route. Relays forward encrypted packets they cannot read, so Zedra never sees your code. Agents still talk to whichever provider you configured them with.

OPEN HOST
The host daemon is open source and runs on macOS and Linux. Install it with one command, keep it running in the background, and pair as many devices as you want.

Requires a Mac or Linux machine running the Zedra host.
